posts.en:
dsh-token-pet is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Cute token-usage widget in the session header: context occupancy, session usage and breakdown, plus date/weekday, weather, 3-day forecast and severe-weather alerts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-cb4add16dca10f9bdb8b.html
